panels.title: Estado de la ingesta
panels.description: Si una fuente lleva horas sin escribir, algo está roto y no va a dar ningún error.

targets.rawSql: SELECT source AS fuente, ran_at AS ultima_ejecucion, rows_written AS filas, ok, round(hours_since::numeric, 1) AS horas_desde FROM v_ingest_status ORDER BY hours_since DESC

panels.title: Partidos huérfanos
panels.description: Terminaron hace más de 8h y siguen sin cerrar. Más de 3 es señal de ingesta rota.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS valor FROM matches WHERE status IN ('scheduled','live') AND kickoff_utc < now() - interval '8 hours' AND kickoff_utc > now() - interval '30 days'

panels.title: Nombres sin emparejar
panels.description: Cada uno son partidos que el sistema nunca verá. Corre scripts/bootstrap_aliases.py

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS valor FROM unresolved_names WHERE NOT resolved
SELECT count(*) AS valor FROM matches WHERE status='scheduled' AND kickoff_utc BETWEEN now() AND now() + interval '10 days'

panels.title: CLV — la métrica que decide si esto funciona
Valor esperado al cierre sin margen, rodante (30 picks)
panels.description: La vara que decide la puerta: cuota tomada contra el cierre de Pinnacle SIN margen. Si vive por debajo de cero durante 300+ picks, no hay edge. El CLV con margen se muestra al lado pero está inflado por el margen. Vacío mientras la publicación siga pausada: la muestra previa está en /control (sombra del criterio sharp).

targets.rawSql: SELECT r.settled_at AS time, avg(r.ev_close_pct) OVER (ORDER BY r.settled_at ROWS BETWEEN 29 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS "EV cierre sin margen 30p", avg(r.clv_pct) OVER (ORDER BY r.settled_at ROWS BETWEEN 29 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS "CLV con margen 30p" FROM pick_results r WHERE r.ev_close_pct IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(r.settled_at) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: P&L acumulado (unidades)
panels.description: Secundario al CLV a propósito. A pocos cientos de picks esto es ruido.

targets.rawSql: SELECT settled_at AS time, sum(profit_units) OVER (ORDER BY settled_at) AS "P&L acumulado" FROM pick_results WHERE $__timeFilter(settled_at) ORDER BY 1

SELECT count(*) AS "Picks", round(avg(r.ev_close_pct)::numeric,2) AS "EV cierre sin margen %", round(avg(r.clv_pct)::numeric,2) AS "CLV con margen %", round((avg(CASE WHEN r.beat_close THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END)*100)::numeric,1) AS "% batió cierre", round(sum(r.profit_units)::numeric,2) AS "P&L u", round((sum(r.profit_units)/NULLIF(sum(p.stake_units),0)*100)::numeric,2) AS "ROI %" FROM pick_results r JOIN picks p USING (pick_id) WHERE r.settled_at > now() - interval '30 days'

panels.title: Predicho vs observado (último reentrenamiento)
panels.description: Un modelo bien calibrado tiene observado ≈ predicho en cada bucket. 'dentro_de_2se' compara contra el error estándar binomial: sin eso, un bucket con n=8 parece una señal.

targets.rawSql: SELECT bucket, n, round(predicho::numeric,3) AS predicho, round(observado::numeric,3) AS observado, round((observado-predicho)::numeric,3) AS desvio, dentro_de_2se FROM v_calibration_bins WHERE window_end = (SELECT max(window_end) FROM calibration_runs) ORDER BY bucket

panels.title: RPS del modelo vs cierre del mercado
panels.description: Menor es mejor. Si tu línea vive por encima de la del mercado, el modelo no aporta información que el mercado no tenga ya.

targets.rawSql: SELECT created_at AS time, rps AS "Modelo", rps_market AS "Cierre de mercado" FROM calibration_runs WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Snapshots de cuotas capturados por día
panels.description: Este dato se acumula gratis y no se puede comprar barato. Cada hueco en esta serie es un día perdido para siempre.

targets.rawSql: SELECT dia AS time, snapshots AS "Snapshots", partidos AS "Partidos" FROM v_odds_growth WHERE $__timeFilter(dia::timestamptz) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Días de histórico acumulados
panels.description: El producto de predicción de movimiento de línea necesita ~365.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(DISTINCT captured_at::date) AS valor FROM odds_snapshots WHERE source = 'the_odds_api'

SELECT batch_date AS fecha, n_predictions AS predicciones, n_picks AS picks, left(chain_sha256, 20) AS chain_hash, published_ref AS publicado_en, created_at AS sellado FROM prediction_batches ORDER BY seq DESC LIMIT 30
